title: Single critical exception defeats repeated default policy
objective: Test whether the model preserves a rare exception against a heavily repeated default policy.

setup.early_instruction: Default policy: standard reports use the VECTOR template. Exception: reports tagged moss-quiet must use the LANTERN template. This exception is authoritative.
setup.distractor_policy: Fill the middle context with many examples where reports use the VECTOR template. Mention VECTOR far more often than LANTERN. Do not repeat the moss-quiet exception.
setup.late_challenge: The final user asks which template to use for a report tagged moss-quiet. The correct answer is LANTERN, with a note that it is the exception to the default.

scoring_notes: Pass requires selecting LANTERN for moss-quiet.
A generic answer that says VECTOR is the default fails unless it explicitly applies LANTERN to moss-quiet.
This is the simplest adversarial low-frequency dependency smoke.
